dashboard.ui.finder.hint: Hits provide a ready-made snippet. Add it to the sources list of the desired playlist – either in the charts.json (if CHARTS_FILE is used) or in the CHARTS variable of the .env. See CHARTS-SOURCES.md for details.
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_sync: Fetches Deezer/Last.fm charts, matches against the library, writes playlists + missing lists.
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_hitparade: Fetches the official Swiss hit parade (top 100) weekly (Sun), matches + writes hitparade.m3u.
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_download: Downloads the missing chart songs via slskd.
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_import: Sorts finished downloads into the library (tags, cover art, loudness).
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_upgrade: Finds low-quality songs in the library and replaces them with better versions.
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_flashback: Collects the rotation of FLASHBACK FM (decade channels) and grows the library – fetching, no playlist.
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_recommend: Grows the library from the listening taste of several ListenBrainz users (fetching, no playlist).
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_songrequest: Web UI to manually request individual songs.
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_digest: Sends a daily Pushover summary of the songs newly added to the library (by source).
dashboard.ui.desc.charts_watchdog: Monitors all services and reports outages via Pushover.
